layers.process: Iguaçu National Park, Brazilian side (Cataratas do Iguaçu): tickets are sold online only, for a chosen day and time. Date and time can be changed twice before first use, subject to availability. Tickets are personal and non-transferable; carry photo ID. No refund for unused tickets.

layers.authority: Urbia Cataratas (concessionaire of the park's visitor services, under ICMBio)
layers.process: From 19 December 2025: Integral ticket R$ 134 (R$ 131 plus R$ 3 voluntary contribution to the Fundo Iguaçu), about A$ 35 (A$1 = R$ 3.8138, Banco Central do Brasil PTAX, 30 Oct 2026). The Brasil/Mercosul category is R$ 121. The page does not name a separate foreign category; Integral is the full-price class.
